_note: Seed data for the allergen tracker. Prep formats only — not guidance on timing, quantity, or medical suitability. Confirm approach with your pediatrician.
_safety_rules_applied: Nut and seed butters always thinned to a smooth, spreadable-to-runny consistency; never served in a thick glob or as whole/chopped nuts
Cow's milk as yogurt/cheese only, not as a drink, before 12 months

recipes.name: Thinned peanut butter oatmeal
recipes.prep: Stir 1 tsp smooth peanut butter into warm oatmeal until fully dissolved and no streaks remain. Loosen with breastmilk, formula, or water to a soft porridge.

recipes.name: Peanut-banana mash
recipes.prep: Mash a ripe banana, whisk in 1 tsp smooth peanut butter thinned with 2 tsp warm water. Serve on a pre-loaded spoon.

recipes.name: Peanut yogurt swirl
recipes.prep: Whisk 1 tsp peanut powder or thinned peanut butter into 2 tbsp full-fat plain yogurt until smooth.
recipes.note: Also exposes dairy — log both, or use a non-dairy yogurt if isolating.

recipes.name: Scrambled egg strips
recipes.prep: Whisk one egg, cook slowly in a little olive oil until fully set, slide out flat and cut into finger-width strips.

recipes.name: Mashed yolk
recipes.prep: Hard-boil an egg, mash the yolk with breastmilk, formula, or water to a smooth paste.
recipes.note: Yolk only — introduce white separately if you want to isolate the two proteins.

recipes.name: Veggie omelet fingers
recipes.prep: Whisk one egg with 1 tbsp finely grated soft-cooked zucchini or sweet potato. Cook flat until set, cut into strips.

recipes.name: Full-fat plain yogurt
recipes.prep: Serve 2-3 tbsp unsweetened whole-milk yogurt on a pre-loaded spoon. Mash in fruit if desired.

recipes.name: Ricotta toast strips
recipes.prep: Spread whole-milk ricotta thinly on lightly toasted bread, cut into finger-width strips.

recipes.name: Cheesy egg scramble
recipes.prep: Fold 1 tbsp finely grated mild cheese into scrambled egg as it sets.

recipes.name: Toast strips
recipes.prep: Lightly toast a slice of plain wheat bread, cut into finger-width strips, top with a thin layer of avocado or thinned nut butter.

recipes.name: Soft pasta spirals
recipes.prep: Boil fusilli or rotini past al dente until very soft. Toss with a little olive oil and serve whole for grasping.

recipes.name: Cream of wheat porridge
recipes.prep: Cook farina with water, breastmilk, or formula to a soft porridge. Stir in fruit puree.

recipes.name: Roasted tofu strips
recipes.prep: Cut firm tofu into finger-width strips, roast at 400F for 20 min until edges firm enough to hold. Cool fully.

recipes.name: Edamame mash
recipes.prep: Steam shelled edamame until very soft, mash thoroughly with a fork, loosen with water. Ensure no whole beans or skins remain.

recipes.name: Soy yogurt with fruit
recipes.prep: Stir mashed fruit into 2-3 tbsp unsweetened plain soy yogurt.

recipes.name: Thinned almond butter porridge
recipes.prep: Whisk 1 tsp smooth almond butter into warm oatmeal until fully incorporated. Loosen to a soft consistency.

recipes.name: Cashew butter on banana
recipes.prep: Thin 1 tsp smooth cashew butter with warm water, spread in a very thin layer along a banana spear.

recipes.name: Walnut butter yogurt
recipes.prep: Whisk 1 tsp smooth walnut butter into plain yogurt until no clumps remain.
recipes.note: Tree nuts are not one allergen — almond, cashew, walnut, pistachio and others are distinct. Log each separately.

recipes.name: Flaked salmon
recipes.prep: Bake a salmon fillet until opaque, cool, flake thoroughly and check by hand for bones. Serve in soft flakes or mixed into mash.

recipes.name: Cod and potato mash
recipes.prep: Poach cod until it flakes, check for bones, mash with cooked potato and a splash of milk or water.

recipes.name: Salmon patties
recipes.prep: Mix flaked cooked salmon with mashed potato, form into small soft patties, pan-fry lightly. Cut into strips.

recipes.name: Shrimp in avocado mash
recipes.prep: Cook shrimp through, mince very finely, fold into mashed avocado. Serve on a pre-loaded spoon.

recipes.name: Crab and avocado
recipes.prep: Fold cooked, well-picked-over crab meat into mashed avocado. Check carefully for shell fragments.

recipes.name: Shrimp pasta
recipes.prep: Mince cooked shrimp finely and toss through very soft pasta with olive oil.
recipes.note: Crustaceans and molluscs are distinct allergen groups — log shrimp, crab, clam separately.

recipes.name: Tahini oatmeal
recipes.prep: Whisk 1 tsp tahini into warm oatmeal until fully dissolved. Loosen with water or milk.

recipes.name: Tahini yogurt dip
recipes.prep: Whisk 1 tsp tahini into 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Serve on a spoon or as a dip for soft veggie spears.

recipes.name: Hummus on toast
recipes.prep: Spread a thin layer of plain, low-salt, tahini-based hummus on toast strips.
recipes.note: Check the label — some hummus contains little or no tahini. Also exposes wheat.
